places.name: Liu Bei's camp on the road

quests.title: A Rider from Beihai
quests.objective: Meet the rider at Pingyuan's gate.
quests.objective_zh: 到平原城门，见那位来使。

quests.title: The Siege of Beihai
quests.objective: Go to Beihai and lift the siege.
quests.objective_zh: 前往北海解围。

quests.title: The Red Banner
quests.objective: Go to Xuzhou, where Cao Cao's army surrounds the city.
quests.objective_zh: 前往徐州，曹军正围着城。

quests.title: The Second Offer
quests.objective: Go to the governor's hall for the victory feast.
quests.objective_zh: 到州衙赴庆功宴。

quests.title: The Third Offer
quests.objective: Go to Tao Qian. He is dying, and has asked for you.
quests.objective_zh: 去见陶谦。他病重，请你去。

quests.title: A Tiger at the Gate
quests.objective: Go out to the road gate. Lü Bu is coming, asking for shelter.
quests.objective_zh: 到城门外去。吕布前来投奔。

quests.title: Two Tigers
quests.objective: Go to the guest hall. An envoy has come from Xu.
quests.objective_zh: 到客厅去。许都来了使者。

quests.title: Zhang Fei's Vow
quests.objective: Go to the muster ground. An order has come to march.
quests.objective_zh: 到校场去。出兵的诏令到了。

quests.title: Hands and Feet
quests.objective: March to Xuyi, against Yuan Shu's general Ji Ling.
quests.objective_zh: 进兵盱眙，迎战袁术大将纪灵。

quests.title: The Halberd at the Gate
quests.objective: Go to Lü Bu's camp. He has called both sides to a feast.
quests.objective_zh: 到吕布营中。他请两家赴宴。

quests.title: The Stolen Horses
quests.objective: Go to the north gate. Lü Bu has come in a rage.
quests.objective_zh: 到北门去。吕布怒气冲冲地来了。

quests.title: Scattered
quests.objective: Go to the west gate. Lü Bu's generals are attacking.
quests.objective_zh: 到西门去。吕布的部将正在攻城。

quests.title: The Huainan Road
quests.objective: Go to Xiapi, where Cao Cao has Lü Bu surrounded.
quests.objective_zh: 前往下邳，曹操已把吕布围住。

quests.title: The Shrine under the Pine
quests.objective: Go to the shrine under the pine by the camp.
quests.objective_zh: 到营边松树下的星君祠去。

quests.title: The Daughter on His Back
quests.objective: Hold the Huainan road.

gate.objective: Post Guan Yu on the west side of the road and Zhang Fei on the east.
gate.objective_zh: 让关羽守路西，张飞守路东。

quests.objective_zh: 守住淮南要路。

quests.title: The White Gate Tower
quests.objective: Go up to the White Gate Tower.

boss.title: Lü Bu, bound at the White Gate
boss.taunt: You are the guest on the dais, and I the prisoner below the steps.
boss.taunt_zh: 公为坐上客，布为阶下囚。

quests.objective_zh: 登上白门楼。

quests.title: The Temple in the Rain
quests.objective: Side story: the old temple, on a night of rain.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：雨夜古寺。

quests.title: Chen Gong Pleads
quests.objective: Side story: Cao Cao's tent, before Xuzhou.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：徐州城外，曹操大帐。

quests.title: The Fire at Puyang
quests.objective: Side story: the gate of Puyang, at night.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：夜里的濮阳城门。

quests.title: Three Plans
quests.objective: Side story: Chen Gong's plans in Lü Bu's hall.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：吕布府中，陈宫献计。

quests.title: The Wine Jars
quests.objective: Side story: Hou Cheng's wine jars.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：侯成的酒。

quests.title: Two Dogs and a Bone
quests.objective: Side story: the Emperor in Li Jue's camp.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：李傕营中的天子。

quests.title: The River at Night
quests.objective: Side story: the river crossing, at night.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：夜渡黄河。

quests.title: Among the Thorns
quests.objective: Side story: the court in burned Luoyang.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：焦土洛阳的朝廷。

quests.title: The Seal in Pawn
quests.objective: Side story: Sun Ce in Yuan Shu's hall.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：袁术府中的孙策。

quests.title: Shenting Ridge
quests.objective: Side story: Shenting Ridge.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：神亭岭。

quests.title: By Noon Tomorrow
quests.objective: Side story: Sun Ce's camp at Jingxian.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：泾县孙策营。

quests.title: The Gate at Wancheng
quests.objective: Side story: Cao Cao's camp gate at Wancheng.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：宛城曹营寨门。

quests.title: The Granary Officer
quests.objective: Side story: the granary officer at the siege of Shouchun.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：寿春城下的管粮官。

quests.title: Father's Essence
quests.objective: Side story: Xiahou Dun on the road to Xiaopei.
quests.objective_zh: 支线：小沛道上的夏侯惇。
